description: A PHP class defining a form processor for admin impact data, including form creation, validation, and saving logic within the Goteo project.

classes.name: AdminImpactDataForm
classes.description: A form processor class for handling impact data forms in the admin panel, including form creation and data saving.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs the form with fields for impact data including title, description, data, image, type, source, result message, operation type, and submit button.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the form data into the ImpactData model, handling image uploads and errors.

methods.name: getImpactDataTypes
methods.description: Retrieves impact data types with localized labels for form choices.

methods.name: getImpactSources
methods.description: Retrieves impact data sources with localized labels for form choices.

methods.name: getImpactOperations
methods.description: Retrieves impact data operations with localized labels for form choices.
